notes.title: Big Rumble Boxing: Creed Champions launches on Steam Today!
notes.notes:
Calling all Boxing Champions! 🥊💥🏆

It's time to lace up your gloves and step into the ring, because we just officially launched Big Rumble Boxing: Creed Champions on Steam! 

Be sure to check out the launch trailer to see what all the rumbling excitement is about:

[previewyoutube=7hv4SE_pBmo;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to bring the Creed and Rocky universe to Steam, and hope you have fun with this classic, arcade slugger that pays homage to one of the most iconic boxing franchises in history. 

Yo Adrian, we did it! 

- Survios

notes.title: Fight as Rocky, Ivan Drago, Clubber Lang, and more in Creed Champions
notes.notes: Today on the IGN Expo Livestream we got a look at Big Rumble Boxing: Creed Champions, and saw a heck of a lot of boxers getting punched in their very familiar faces. Check out the trailer above... Read more.
